message.content:
**Battle of Waterloo (1815)** – Casualty Estimates | Side | Approximate Total Losses* | |------|---------------------------| | **French Army** | ~25–30 000 killed, wounded, missing | | **Allied Coalition Forces**
(British‑Dutch‑German + Prussian) | ~20–22 000 killed, wounded, missing | \*Numbers vary slightly among contemporary reports and modern scholarship: 1. **Killing & Wounding:** - French: 12 500–15 000 dead, 10 000–13 000 wounded. - Allies: 8 000–9 000 dead, 11 000–12 000 wounded. 2. **Missing/Prisoners:** - French: 2 000–3 000 captured/missing. - Allies: 1 200–1 800 captured/missing. These totals include all combatants on both sides—infantry, cavalry, artillery—and account for those who died from wounds later as well as immediate battlefield fatalities. While exact counts differ across primary accounts, most historians converge around the ranges above.
